fusions.name: Final Exhale
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health, a threshold that rises with each rank. The squeeze deals 20 damage, consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.4 times their remaining damage, and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Pit of Many
fusions.desc: A ring of vipers that deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaves each [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Living Palisade
fusions.desc: Raises a wall of coils 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it, and anything that touches it moves 25% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Each Breath Tighter
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 8. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes it for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (218% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
